provenance: All values derive from the pinned official OTA (see ha100_official_runtime.json for the byte-identical archive/member pins). boot and odmdtbo are direct ZIP members. The formatter and checker live inside the reconstructed system image and are re-extracted to confirm their hashes. The stock userdata image is generated fresh by make_f2fs, so it has no reproducible hash; it is verified structurally (both F2FS superblocks) and against the owner's per-build receipt, never against a pinned content hash. The installer always fetches the OTA from the vendor source at install time and trusts only these repo-pinned hashes; nothing here redistributes firmware bytes.
